name: tabular_statsforecast
title: Classical forecasting: SARIMAX and Prophet on one weekly series, cut by timestamp
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the statsmodels / Prophet shape the rule set has never been measured on

forbidden.why: the Box-Cox transform is fitted on `history` only, after split_by_time has already cut the series at a timestamp; nothing is fitted on the whole frame
the future window reaches two calls, fitted.forecast and mean_absolute_percentage_error, and is never fitted on

the holdout is frame.loc[frame.index < cutoff]; this project never shuffles and never calls train_test_split - three temporal signals and no random split is exactly the correct pattern MLV106 asks for
Prophet's rolling-origin cross_validation refits the whole model per fold; there is no scikit-learn transformer for it to sit outside of
SARIMAX, Prophet and seasonal_decompose are deterministic given their inputs; a random_state would have nothing to seed, and inventing one would be wrong advice
there is no splitter object here at all - the split is a timestamp comparison
the only metric is mean_absolute_percentage_error on a continuous target
no torch, no gradients and no hand-written update step
model.eval() has no statsmodels or Prophet equivalent
the .fit() calls here belong to SARIMAX and Prophet; neither is a Keras model and neither has a compile step
